name: The Horde Needs More Copper Bars!
label: Quest
description: The Horde Needs More Copper Bars!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Back so soon? You'll be a real miner in no time adventurer. So, you already know the drill; I need you to go out, mine up a mess of copper ore, smelt it into bars and bring it back to me here. I know that's something you're capable of, the question is, are you willing?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Back so soon? You'll be a real miner in no time, adventurer. So, you already know the drill; I need you to go out, mine up a mess of copper ore, smelt it into bars and bring it back to me here. I know that's something you're capable of, the question is, are you willing?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've proven yourself to me yet again, adventurer. I will see to it that this copper is used in due time. For now though, I need to get these copper bars onto the pallet and tallied. If you still feel inclined, I could probably use your help in gathering even more copper bars.
